data.description:
Cutover + rollback dry-run. Single cutover commit deletes both bridge workflow files. Rollback playbook on throwaway branch: revert + restore cursors + remove bridge_state/ + verify old bridges run one scheduled cycle.

## Done Definitions
- Single commit removes both .github/workflows/bridge-outbound.yml and .github/workflows/inbound-bridge.yml with no other functional changes ← Satisfies: sc-7
- On throwaway branch, rollback playbook executes cleanly with no manual fixups ← Satisfies: sc-7
- Post-rollback old bridge workflows complete one scheduled cycle successfully (gh run list confirms) ← Satisfies: sc-7

## Considerations
- [Closure Check] Cutover commit must also clean up documentation/scripts referencing old bridge files.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
data.title: As a bridge operator, I want the cutover commit plus a rollback dry-run that restores the old bridges, so that I can prove rollback works before relying on it in production.
